learning_outcomes.text: Refinement and enrichment of basic mathematical tools (series, curves, several types of integral, differential equations) for solving typical problems in applies sciences.

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus of functions of several real variables
Measure and integration in the sense of Lebesgue
assessment_rules: The exam is exclusively written, divided into three parts. The maximum score for the first part is 10. For the second part, a correct answer is worth 3, an incorrect answer is -1, and an unanswered question is 0. Candidates must obtain a total of 11 points in the first two parts (out of a theoretical maximum of 22) to be admitted to the third part. The third part has a maximum score of 12 points, and a score lower than 4 in this part is considered a failure. The exam is also failed if the total score, including that of the first two parts, is lower than 17. If the total score is at least 17, the exam is considered passed with a score equal to the score obtained plus 1.
